governance: All counterfactual families registered BEFORE evaluation. No post-hoc additions. All trials reported including failures. Family-wise Bonferroni alpha=0.05/n_family on bootstrap mean-difference tests vs control. Control = frozen R4 exits (rotation/sign-flip/regime-ride).

evaluation_basis.cost_model: 10 bps per side; slippage sensitivity 15 bps/side for survivors
evaluation_basis.stop_trigger: D1 high/low touch; pessimistic same-bar priority stop-before-TP; gap fill at open when gapped through
evaluation_basis.oos_protocol: calendar-half split + yearly consistency + block-bootstrap p-values; purged walk-forward reference on control curve via existing analytics machinery
evaluation_basis.data_limitation: H1 data available only for AUDUSD/EURUSD/GBPUSD subset -> H1-refined trigger sensitivity run ONLY on that subset to quantify D1-trigger bias

families.name: fixed_pct_stops
families.hypothesis: Fixed-price catastrophic stops reduce tail without destroying expectancy

families.name: atr_multiple_stops
families.hypothesis: Volatility-scaled stops adapt to instrument noise
families.note: Numerically identical to R-multiple stops under preregistered R:=ATR14 definition; F2 covers the prompt's ATR and R-based lists.

families.name: trailing_exits
families.hypothesis: Trails protect profit vs cutting winners (ambiguous)

families.name: signal_regime_exits
families.hypothesis: Policy-level exits (regime-OFF flatten, deep-rank decay) improve risk without killing tail

param.note: already natural exit in control; retained as identity check

families.name: time_stops
families.hypothesis: Cut losers early / cap episode length; does expectancy improve or does it remove trades pre-development

acceptance_criteria.economic_variant: Sharpe_delta_vs_control > 0 AND bootstrap_p_family_corrected < 0.05 AND MaxDD not worse than control*1.1 AND yearly_consistency >= 0.5
acceptance_criteria.catastrophic_layer: evaluated separately on containment criteria (P99 loss reduction >= 50% with expectancy drag <= 15% relative); NOT required to beat control on Sharpe
